are_you_ok.title: Denver health specialists warn of extreme heat risks for people and pets
are_you_ok.summary: A record-shattering heat wave defined the week: health specialists warned of extreme risk mid-week (Jul 25), Sunday (Jul 27) became Denver's hottest day in 8+ years, and the following night was the warmest in 145 years — a sustained event touching everyone the reader could check on.
are_you_ok.description: With continued high temperatures across Colorado, it's important to recognize the symptoms of heat related illness. Health experts are sharing tips to protect yourself and your pets this weekend.

thread.title: Sunday was Denver's hottest day in more than 8 years
thread.summary: Record heat day, acute weather event.
thread.description: Denver experiences record-breaking heat as temperatures reach 103 degrees, the highest in over eight years.

thread.title: Denver just had its warmest night in 145 years
thread.summary: Record heat/warmest night affects broad metro population; a discrete heat event people would check in about.
thread.description: Denver experienced its warmest official overnight low in 145 years due to cloud cover trapping heat after a record-breaking high of 103 degrees.

are_you_ok.title: Friends rally for woman detained by ICE at Denver airport
are_you_ok.summary: ICE detained a woman at Denver airport (Jul 24) as friends rallied on her behalf — a wrenching local enforcement moment likely to weigh on anyone with immigrant ties in the metro.
are_you_ok.description: A friend and former employer of a woman detained by federal agents at Denver International Airport has been advocating for her release from detention.

conversation_starters.description: Arguably the world’s greatest rock and roll band, AC/DC is back in Colorado for the first time in 10 years, ready to rock Colorado's largest stadium on Tuesday.

thread.title: Colorado Department of Transportation begins mudslide cleanup, expect delays on Highway 550
thread.summary: Highway 550 mudslide cleanup/delays; distant mountain-pass route, not Denver metro. Conversation starter for most readers. You could open with: 'Heard Red Mountain Pass is a mess with the mudslide cleanup?'
thread.description: The Colorado Department of Transportation is advising drivers to expect lengthy delays this week as crews clean up the remains of a mudslide in Red Mountain Pass.
